alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued 2022-12-28T20:04:00Z until 2022-12-29T19:00:00Z by NWS Wasatch Mountains I-80 North
alerts.description:
...WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY NOW IN EFFECT FROM 9 AM THIS MORNING
TO MIDNIGHT CST TONIGHT...
...WIND CHILL ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM MIDNIGHT TONIGHT TO 10 AM
CST SATURDAY...
* WHAT...For the Winter Weather Advisory, snow expected. Total
snow accumulations of up to two inches. Winds gusting as high
as 40 mph. For the Wind Chill Advisory, very cold wind chills
expected. Wind chills as low as 30 below zero.
* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Minnesota and
northeast and southeast North Dakota.
* WHEN...For the Winter Weather Advisory, from 9 AM this morning
to midnight CST tonight. For the Wind Chill Advisory, from
midnight tonight to 10 AM CST Saturday.
* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. Snow and blowing
snow could significantly reduce visibility. The hazardous
conditions could impact the evening commute. The dangerously
cold wind chills could cause frostbite on exposed skin in as
little as 10 minutes.
